message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: a party secretary (village party branch secretary) received money from a real estate developer's representative during construction of a new village. He received multiple payments totaling 470,000 RMB, via his father-in-law's bank account and directly. This is classic bribery (受贿). Also possibly abuse of power? The charge likely is "受贿" (accepting bribes). Could also be "滥用职权" if he used his position to benefit the developer, but the facts only mention receiving money, not specific acts of favor. The typical charge: "受贿罪". In examples, they label "受贿". So answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>
